question: What immense wealth is imagined as insufficient compared to this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Such wealth is treated as an accumulation
It is posed as a comparative measure
inference: Even an accumulation vast enough to fill the ocean with jewels is not comparable.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused form with unclear internal segmentation
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to make the ocean filled with jewels...
